releaseNotesMarkdown:
### open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib)

### [`v0.164.0`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v01640)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.163.2...v0.164.0)

##### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `otelcol-contrib`: Add the partitioning processor to the Contrib distribution ([#​1727](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1727))

##### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `otelcol`: Add the `file_log` receiver, `resource_detection` processor and `transform` processor to the core distribution. ([#​44130](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/44130))
  These Contrib components are priorities for stabilization.
  See [open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib#44130](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/issues/44130).

##### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `all`: Build release binaries with Go 1.26.10 and require Alpine `ca-certificates` [`2026102`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/commit/20261020)-r0 or later in container images. ([#​1722](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1722))
  Go 1.26.10 includes the `crypto/x509` security fixes released on 2026-10-19.
  The updated CA bundle removes the distrusted eMudhra emSign roots, including `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`.

### [`v0.163.2`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.163.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.163.1...v0.163.2)

This release updates the binaries' Go version and CA bundle. It fixes [#​1722](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1722).

To see the collector changes in v0.163.x see [v0.163.0](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.163.0)

- [`94fec53`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/commit/94fec53ca1bf43dd47f180067db5675328705fde) Update golang:1.27-alpine3.23 Docker digest to [`895e5fe`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/commit/895e5fe) ([#​1720](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1720))

### [`v0.163.1`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v01631)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.162.0...v0.163.1)

### [`v0.162.0`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v01620)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.161.0...v0.162.0)

##### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `otelcol-contrib`: Remove `wavefrontreceiver` from the contrib distribution after its deprecation period. ([#​1673](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1673))

##### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `otelcol-contrib`: Add `sdnotifyextension` to the contrib distribution. ([#​49607](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/49607))

- `otelcol-prometheus`: Create the new otelcol-prometheus distribution, which includes "Prometheus exporters" as metric receivers. ([#​1618](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1618))
  The new otelcol-prometheus distribution is a collaboration between the Prometheus and OpenTelemetry communities.
  Existing [Prometheus exporters](https://prometheus.io/docs/instrumenting/exporters/) are slowly being refactored to be usable as Collector receivers in custom Collector distributions built with OCB.

  As more Prometheus exporters are refactored to be usable as Collector receivers, we will add them to the otelcol-prometheus distribution.

  The otelcol-prometheus distribution is experimental, and is not recommended for production use.

  [Build a custom Collector distribution](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/extend/ocb/) if you need components from other OpenTelemetry Collector distributions such as contrib.

- `receiver/blackbox`: Add the [Prometheus blackbox_exporter](https://redirect.github.com/prometheus/blackbox_exporter) as a receiver for probe metrics in otelcol-prometheus distribution. ([#​1664](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1664))

- `receiver/postgres`: Add the [Prometheus postgres_exporter](https://redirect.github.com/prometheus-community/postgres_exporter) as a receiver for PostgreSQL metrics in otelcol-prometheus distribution. ([#​1664](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1664))
